name: @mnemopay/augengine-detective
description: Gate-4 game core for AugEngine: an original detective case (The Wrenfield Observatory) as deterministic game state, a rule engine for actions, suspect personas with scripted lie policies, guardrail validators for LLM dialogue, an offline dialogue fallback, and per-player suspect memory. No engine or DOM dependency, so the browser game and the MCP server share it.
author: Jeremiah Omiagbo (Blackpig Films LLC)
